mapper.select: SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(u.id) FROM users u WHERE u.id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{userId}) AND u.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND u.deleted_at <= #{cutoff} AND u.role != 'BOT' FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM messages WHERE sender_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{userId}) OR receiver_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{userId})
DELETE FROM watching_sessions WHERE watcher_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{userId})
DELETE FROM reviews WHERE author_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{userId})
DELETE FROM users WHERE id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{userId}) AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at <= #{cutoff} AND role != 'BOT'
